items.title: Week ahead for traders: FOMC, BoE, BoJ, US PCE and GDP create major cross-asset risk
items.summary: The week ahead brings an unusually concentrated sequence of central-bank decisions, inflation reports and growth data. The Federal Reserve, Bank of England and Bank of Japan will all be in focus, while US GDP, core PCE inflation, Eurozone CPI and Australian CPI may materially change expectations for interest rates.
items.impactZh: 央行政策预期变化可能提升主要货币对波动，杠杆仓位的保证金与回撤压力上升。
items.impactEn: Shifts in central-bank expectations may increase major-pair volatility and raise margin/drawdown pressure on leveraged positions.
items.summaryZh: 未来一周将出现一系列异常集中的央行决策、通胀报告和增长数据。美联储、英格兰银行和日本银行都将成为焦点，而美国GDP、核心PCE通胀、欧元区CPI和澳大利亚CPI可能会大幅改变利率预期。
